hardwareHubs.note: Terrapin Works at the University of Maryland reports over 100 3D printers and 28,000 square feet of fabrication lab space.

makerspaces.name: Terrapin Works
makerspaces.note: University of Maryland rapid prototyping service that lists 3D printing, laser cutting, metalworking, scanning and electronics help for the campus and surrounding community.

programs.name: TEDCO
programs.note: Maryland government organization that funds innovation and startups through its MyTEDCO portal, with no hardware-specific service described on its page.

support.name: Maryland MEP (MD MEP)
support.note: Nonprofit NIST MEP center in Columbia that helps small and mid-size manufacturers, including finding suppliers for prototype parts.
